sentences.en: Koalas have especially sharp claws, which help them climb trees.
sentences.zh: 考拉有特别锋利的爪子，这有助于它们爬树。

sentences.en: A sexually transmitted disease – chlamydia – is also harming koalas’ health.
sentences.zh: 一种性传播疾病——衣原体——也正在损害考拉的健康。

sentences.en: Do you want to cuddle a koala? Come to Austria!
sentences.zh: 你想拥抱一只考拉吗？来奥地利吧！

senses.zh: 树袋熊，无尾熊（产于澳大利亚，又名考拉）
